automaster.title: AutoMaster — Automotive Service Platform
automaster.desc: AutoMaster is a digital service platform designed to connect vehicle owners with automotive service professionals.
automaster.longDesc: The platform enables car owners to discover nearby automotive workshops, inspect verified specialist profiles, book service appointments online, and track job statuses in real time. For service stations and master technicians, it provides a full order dispatching workflow, schedule planner, automated notifications, and an administrative management dashboard.

bizos.title: BIZOS — Business Process Automation
bizos.desc: BIZOS focuses on business process systematization and automation. Within BIZOS, I work on improving company workflows through digital systems, CRM solutions, integrations, automation, and modern technologies.
bizos.longDesc: Under the BIZOS umbrella, company sales funnels, customer communication channels, task tracking, and financial analytics are unified into an automated operational engine, drastically cutting costs and human error.

process.title: An 8-step structured path from vision to production

step1.title: Discovery
step1.desc: Initial consultation to explore business goals, target audience, technical scope, and project objectives.

step2.title: Analysis
step2.desc: Competitive research, technical feasibility assessment, and defining the optimal system architecture.

step3.title: Architecture
step3.desc: Designing relational database schemas, REST APIs, state flows, and data security protocols.

step4.title: Design
step4.desc: Crafting intuitive UX wireframes and high-conversion modern UI components tailored to your brand.

step5.title: Development
step5.desc: Writing clean, maintainable, and modular code according to enterprise development best practices.

step6.title: Testing
step6.desc: Comprehensive QA testing across mobile and desktop devices, load testing, and security checks.

step7.title: Launch

step8.title: Support
step8.desc: Ongoing maintenance, feature enhancements, stability monitoring, and prompt technical support.
